setting.help: How an order taken in the app becomes a document in Odoo.
setting.div: On this flow the quotation goes to the distributor, so the sale price of a product follows its PTS. Use "Set Sale Price from PTS" on the product list to bring products already in the system onto their PTS.

setting.help: The field picks its outlet demands in the app, chooses a distributor and sends them on as one order, then shares the printed outlet summary. Each employee can be moved off this on their own form.
